function.name: stub_syscall
function.description: This function sets up a context and an exception record, gets the current thread context, sets the exception address based on the architecture, and raises an exception.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: This parameter is used to set the second exception information in the exception record.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value

function.name: init
function.description: This function initializes the system service table and adds system call debug info. In a 64-bit Windows environment, it also queries system information and sets the 'zero_bits' variable.

parameters.name: args
parameters.description: This parameter is not used in the function.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, represents the status of the function execution. The function always returns STATUS_SUCCESS.
